summary: Read an array of integers that is already arranged from small to large. Organize it as a binary search tree, and require that the left side and the right side of every node differ in height by at most one. Height is the count of nodes on the longest downward route from the node in question. Any shape is acceptable when it keeps search order and this height limit. Write the tree you build. An empty array produces an empty tree.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
